axes: native ZYX, transverse XY, positive Z slice order
rule: 7 consecutive native slices centered at rounded median Z of sealed T10 crop; entire crop projected XY bbox plus128 native pixels, rounded outward to128. Geometry selects acquisition bounds ONLY.
xy_preprocessing: exact4x4 mean with half-even uint8 rounding; pixel(i,j) maps native XY=(x0+4*j+1.5,y0+4*i+1.5); no Z pooling
registration: same scan-ID native XYZ identity; physical error not independently calibrated
